def read_telemetry(reference):
 assert ref(reference['path'])==reference
 t=json.loads(gzip.decompress(Path(reference['path']).read_bytes()))
 assert t['telemetry_status']=='complete' and not t['missing_required_signals']
 assert t['stride']==1 and t['step_dt_seconds']==.02
 return t
def augment(data):

 cmd=np.array([z['command'] for z in s],float)

 pos=np.array([z['root_position_w'] for z in s],float)
 done=np.array([z['done'] for z in s],bool)
 valid=np.ones(n,bool)
 for d in np.where(done)[0]:valid[d:min(n,d+50)]=False
 assert n==r['duration_steps'] and all(np.isfinite(z).all() for z in [v,cmd,w,pos])
 windows=old['method']['turn_stages_half_open_steps'] if n==4500 else {'startup_0_1s':[0,50],'standing_1_40s':[50,2000],'standing_40_120s':[2000,6000]}
 for name,(lo,hi) in windows.items():
  ix=np.arange(lo,hi)[valid[lo:hi]]
  stage=data['stages'][name]
  stage['tracking_vx_rmse_m_s']=float(np.sqrt(np.mean((v[ix,0]-cmd[ix,0])**2))) if len(ix) else None
  stage['tracking_vy_rmse_m_s']=float(np.sqrt(np.mean((v[ix,1]-cmd[ix,1])**2))) if len(ix) else None
  stage['body_vx_rms_m_s']=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(v[ix,0]**2))) if len(ix) else None
  stage['body_vy_rms_m_s']=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(v[ix,1]**2))) if len(ix) else None
  if not done[lo:hi].any():
   stage['xy_path_length_m']=float(np.sum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(pos[lo:hi,:2],axis=0),axis=1)))
   stage['xy_max_excursion_from_window_start_m']=float(np.max(np.linalg.norm(pos[lo:hi,:2]-pos[lo,:2],axis=1)))
  else:
   stage['xy_path_length_m']=None;stage['xy_max_excursion_from_window_start_m']=None
 if n==6000:
  if not done.any():
   def net(lo,hi):return float(np.linalg.norm(pos[hi-1,:2]-pos[lo,:2]))
   vx=v[2000:,0];freq=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(vx),d=.02)
   power=abs(np.fft.rfft(vx-vx.mean()))**2
   band=(freq>=.05)&(freq<=25)
   data['zero_command_diagnostics']={
    'initial_0_40s_net_xy_displacement_m':net(0,2000),
    'full_0_120s_net_xy_displacement_m':net(0,6000),
    'steady_40_120s_net_xy_displacement_m':net(2000,6000),
    'steady_vx_mean_m_s':float(vx.mean()),
    'steady_vx_rms_m_s':float(np.sqrt(np.mean(vx**2))),
    'steady_vx_min_max_m_s':[float(vx.min()),float(vx.max())],
    'steady_vx_dominant_frequency_0p05_25Hz':float(freq[band][np.argmax(power[band])]) if power[band].max()>0 else None,
    'steady_vx_frequency_bin_Hz':float(freq[1]-freq[0]),
    'endpoint_time_span_initial_s':(2000-1)*.02,
    'endpoint_time_span_full_s':(6000-1)*.02,
    'endpoint_time_span_steady_s':(6000-2000-1)*.02,
    'method':'Post-step positions; net endpoint displacement is distinct from path length and velocity RMS; frequency peak from demeaned rectangular-window RFFT, descriptive only.'
   }

   data['zero_command_diagnostics']={'status':'unavailable_window_contains_reset'}
